memory_high: Memory usage reached {peak_pct}% of the {limit_mb} MB limit at {time}. It is recommended to move to {next_label} ({next_memory_gb} GB at ${next_price} per month, an additional ${price_delta} per month) or to reduce the peak memory usage. Prices are as of {prices_date}; please verify them at {pricing_url}.
memory_high_import: Memory usage reached {peak_pct}% of the {limit_mb} MB limit at {time}, while an import was running. It is recommended to import the data in smaller batches or to move to {next_label} ({next_memory_gb} GB at ${next_price} per month, an additional ${price_delta} per month). Prices are as of {prices_date}; please verify them at {pricing_url}.
memory_high_max: Memory usage reached {peak_pct}% of the {limit_mb} MB limit at {time}, and no larger instance type is available in the price table. It is recommended to reduce the memory usage or to request a custom instance type from Render.
memory_high_max_import: Memory usage reached {peak_pct}% of the {limit_mb} MB limit at {time}, while an import was running, and no larger instance type is available in the price table. It is recommended to import the data in smaller batches.
memory_oom: The service ran out of memory {oom_count} time(s), most recently at {time}, and was restarted by Render. It is recommended to move to {next_label} ({next_memory_gb} GB at ${next_price} per month, an additional ${price_delta} per month) or to reduce the peak memory usage. Prices are as of {prices_date}; please verify them at {pricing_url}.
memory_oom_max: The service ran out of memory {oom_count} time(s), most recently at {time}, and no larger instance type is available in the price table. It is recommended to reduce the memory usage or to request a custom instance type from Render.
deploy_failed: The latest deploy failed ({status}) at {time}. Commit: {commit} "{message}". Reason: {reason}.
deploy_failed_recovered: A deploy failed today at {time} ({failed_count} failed in total). Commit: {commit} "{message}". Reason: {reason}. A later deploy is now live.
deploy_failed_earlier: A deploy failed today at {time} ({failed_count} failed in total). Commit: {commit} "{message}". Reason: {reason}. No later deploy has gone live yet.
many_deploys_disk: {count} deploys today restarted this service. Because the service has a {disk_gb} GB disk, zero-downtime deploys are not available, and every deploy that passes the build stage stops the service until the new instance is running. These deploys took approximately {deploy_min} minutes in total, including the build. It is recommended to combine commits into fewer deploys, or to configure build filters so that changes to documentation and tests do not trigger a deploy.
latency_spike_import: Response times were elevated: the p95 response time reached {p95_ms} ms at {time} (typically {median_ms} ms) while an import was running. It is recommended to run imports during a quiet period or in smaller batches.
latency_spike_deploy: Response times were elevated: the p95 response time reached {p95_ms} ms at {time} (typically {median_ms} ms) during a deploy. It is recommended to deploy during a quiet period.
latency_spike_import_deploy: Response times were elevated: the p95 response time reached {p95_ms} ms at {time} (typically {median_ms} ms) while an import and a deploy were running.
latency_spike_unknown: Response times were elevated: the p95 response time reached {p95_ms} ms at {time} (typically {median_ms} ms), and no import or deploy was running at that time. It is recommended to review the slow requests in the logs.
slow_spike_import: {count} slow requests were logged in the hour beginning at {time}, while an import was running. Number of such hours today: {hours}.
slow_spike_deploy: {count} slow requests were logged in the hour beginning at {time}, during a deploy. Number of such hours today: {hours}.
slow_spike_import_deploy: {count} slow requests were logged in the hour beginning at {time}, while an import and a deploy were running. Number of such hours today: {hours}.
slow_spike_unknown: {count} slow requests were logged in the hour beginning at {time}, and no import or deploy was running at that time. Number of such hours today: {hours}.
disk_high: The disk is {used_pct}% full ({used_gb} of {size_gb} GB). It is recommended to remove data that is no longer needed or to increase the disk size to {suggest_gb} GB (an additional ${extra_cost} per month). Prices are as of {prices_date}; please verify them at {pricing_url}.
suspended: The service is suspended (by {by}), so its instances are not billed (${running_cost} per month when running). If the service is no longer needed, it is recommended to delete it. Prices are as of {prices_date}; please verify them at {pricing_url}.
suspended_disk: The service is suspended (by {by}). Its instances are not billed while it is suspended, but its disk is (${monthly_cost} per month at present, ${running_cost} per month when running). If the service is no longer needed, it is recommended to delete it. Prices are as of {prices_date}; please verify them at {pricing_url}.
idle: The service received no requests in the last 24 hours but costs ${monthly_cost} per month. If it is not needed, it is recommended to suspend it or to move it to a smaller instance type. Prices are as of {prices_date}; please verify them at {pricing_url}.
reason_oom: the service ran out of memory
reason_no_port: the service never opened its port
reason_timeout: the service timed out while starting
reason_exit_code: the application exited with an error
reason_early_exit: the application stopped immediately after starting
reason_unknown: unknown; please refer to the deploy log
